name: DVS Resource Map
description: This dataset lists 253 social service resources for veterans, with each row representing one location or program. Fields include a resource ID, the organization or site name, the type of service offered, operating hours, phone number, street address, city, state, ZIP code, building details, borough, whether walk-ins are accepted, email address, website, and a free-text description of service details. The data supports finding nearby services, comparing hours and contact options, filtering by borough or walk-in availability, and building referral directories or maps for veterans seeking assistance.
prompt:
Title: DVS Resource Map
Category: Social Services
Rows (sampled): 253
Columns: 15
Column names: dvs_res_id, name, service, hours, phone_number, address, city, state, zip, building_details, borough, walk_in, email_address, website, service_details

Write a clear description of this dataset.
